Use input to capture text edits or change for the committed DOM change. The payload value is a string. FileList and bind:files are native Svelte features.

## Usage

```ts
import { input, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/input';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/input`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

### Example View

Register the `input` set and pass this JSON as `view` to `renderer.mount`.

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "name",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Input",
    "inputs": {
      "aria-label": "Name",
      "value": "Ada"
    }
  }
}
```

The textbox starts with “Ada” and accepts edits. To store edits in State, follow the [input binding example](../../guides/compose-json/#write-user-edits-to-state).

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-input"></a>

The [DOM events for this part](../../attributes/#dom-67a0f1612c) use a [direct payload](../../support/#event-payloads).

Props that need native code or are mapped to a different JSON event `files`.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
